[center]
[size=6][b][color=#42BDF2]BENTLEYPLAYZ[/color] [color=#FFD45C]MORE DRINKS[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][color=#B8D9F2]A New Beverage Experience in Stardew Valley![/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#42BDF2]50 COFFEES • 50 TEAS • A NEW SALOON EXPERIENCE[/color][/size]
[/center]

[line]

[center][size=5][b][color=#FFD45C]WELCOME TO MORE DRINKS![/color][/b][/size][/center]

Ready for something new to drink?

BentleyPlayz More Drinks is an expansion project for Stardew Valley that aims to bring an extensive selection of original beverages to the Valley.

With 100 planned beverages, including 50 coffees and 50 teas, there's plenty to discover!

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#42BDF2]FEATURES[/color][/b][/size]

[size=4][b][color=#FFD45C]100 ORIGINAL BEVERAGES[/color][/b][/size]

- 50 unique coffees.
- 50 unique teas.
- Individual drink names and descriptions.
- Individual prices and item data.
- Custom beverage sprites.

[size=4][b][color=#FFD45C]A NEW SALOON EXPERIENCE[/color][/b][/size]

Discover a dedicated More Drinks counter inside Gus's Stardrop Saloon.

The integration is designed to preserve Gus's original inventory and existing shop functionality.

[size=4][b][color=#FFD45C]MEET GIDEON![/color][/b][/size]

Meet Gideon, Gus's cousin!

Gideon staffs the new beverage counter and has his own appearance, dialogue, and introduction.

He is available at the counter around the clock.

[size=4][b][color=#FFD45C]SPECIAL COMMUNITY SHOUTOUT[/color][/b][/size]

This project features a special shoutout to Twitch streamer HunnyBwat during initialization!

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#42BDF2]COMPATIBILITY[/color][/b][/size]

- Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3
- SMAPI 4.3.2.5
- Android compatibility target.
- Compatible desktop installations targeted.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#42BDF2]INSTALLATION[/color][/b][/size]

1. Install Stardew Valley.
2. Install SMAPI.
3. Install the required dependencies.
4. Extract the mod archive into your Mods folder.
5. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#42BDF2]CREDITS[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#42BDF2][b]Developer: Bentley Playz[/b][/color]

Special thanks to HunnyBwat for the community shoutout!

[line]

[center]
[size=5][b][color=#FFD45C]THANK YOU FOR SUPPORTING BENTLEYPLAYZ![/color][/b][/size]
[color=#B8D9F2]Enjoy your drinks in Stardew Valley![/color]
[/center]
